DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Administrator email created on first boot. Change at deploy time, then sign in with this address.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Administrator password (min 8 chars). Auto-generated; save from Variables after deploy.

DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: When true, open self-registration is turned off after the admin is created.

DATABASUS_URL.description: Public base URL used in email links. Generate a Railway domain first.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Railway Bucket S3 endpoint. Paste into Databasus → Storages → S3.

S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket name for backup archives.
